probe.text_sample: Your Page Title kinfolk ® Shop Journal Help About Contact Overview Buy Kinfolk 0 0 0 0 Categories Show all 13 Face 5 Body 4 Refills 3 Gift cards 1 Restorative face oil €64 Hydrating serum €58 Body oil €48 Gift card From €25 Shop Journal Help About Contact Overview Buy Kinfolk Account Help Help Shipping Returns Contact Terms Privacy Cookies Help / Orders How do I track my order? As soon as your parcel leaves our studio, we send you an email with a tracking link. Most orders are packed and handed to the courier on the same working day if you order before 2 pm. Where to find your tracking link In your inbox. Look for an email titled “Your Kinfolk order is on its way”. The tracking link is at the top. In your account. Sign in , open Orders and select the order. The tracking number and the courier are listed next to the delivery address. If you checked out without an account, the email is the only place we send it, so check your spam folder before writing to us. What the tracking status means Label created. We have packed your order and the courier has its details, but has not collected it yet. In transit. Your parcel is moving between depots. It can stay on this status for a day or two
